design.decision: Build the run around side-suit length and honors instead of [♠]s, cash long suits to the end, and bid every side-suit winner as a sure trick.
design.opponent: Shown the first time a ruff fails; opponents can only win by out-ranking in the led suit or leading [♠], so they hoard [♠]s to lead and draw.
design.rationale: This is a run-defining rule change built on the existing untrumpable hook with no filter: Spades turns into a side-suit game for one team, which is memorable and useful before any payoff. It is likely near the power ceiling, and if it breaks it, the fallback filter is [10] through [A].
design.draftText: Your team's cards can't be trumped

critic.concerns: Players may read the text as protecting your team's own ruffs from overruffs, which the kernel does not do (only cards following a non-[♠] led suit are shielded); a strong rule change opponents can only answer by leading [♠].
